title: The Kalopaideia French Examination
instructions: Three hours, no notes for Part A; printed lexicon and grammar permitted for Part B. Honor code: you affirm by submitting that you used only permitted aids. A failed examination may be retaken after thirty days.

items.prompt_french: Le silence éternel de ces espaces infinis m'effraie.
reference: the eternal silence of these infinite spaces frightens me
the eternal silence of these infinite spaces terrifies me

items.prompt_french: Ce que nous prenons pour des vertus n'est souvent qu'un assemblage de diverses actions.
reference: what we take for virtues is often only an assemblage of various actions
what we consider virtues is often just a collection of different actions

items.prompt_french: Le cœur a ses raisons que la raison ne connaît point.
reference: the heart has its reasons which reason does not know
the heart has its reasons that reason knows nothing of

items.prompt_french: Pendant un demi-siècle, les bourgeoises de Pont-l'Évêque envièrent à Mme Aubain sa servante Félicité.
reference: for half a century, the bourgeois women of pont-l'eveque envied mme aubain her servant felicite
for fifty years, the townswomen of pont-l'eveque envied madame aubain her servant felicite

items.prompt_french: Elle crut voir, dans les cieux entr'ouverts, un perroquet gigantesque, planant au-dessus de sa tête.
reference: she believed she saw, in the half-open heavens, a gigantic parrot, hovering above her head
she thought she saw, in the opened skies, a huge parrot, flying above her head

items.prompt_french: Quand le ciel bas et lourd pèse comme un couvercle sur l'esprit gémissant en proie aux longs ennuis.
reference: when the low and heavy sky weighs like a lid on the groaning spirit prey to long ennuis
when the heavy low sky weighs like a cover on the groaning mind beset by long boredom

items.prompt_french: Là, tout n'est qu'ordre et beauté, luxe, calme et volupté.
reference: there, all is only order and beauty, luxury, calm and voluptuousness
there, everything is order and beauty, luxury, peace and pleasure

items.prompt: Parse the form 'parlais'. Give: person, number, tense, mood, voice.
Parse the form 'parlerai'. Give: person, number, tense, mood, voice.
Parse the form 'qu'il parle'. Give: person, number, tense, mood, voice.
Parse the noun form 'maisons'. Give: gender, number, article required.
Render in French: 'The king is dead.'
Render in French: 'I have some bread.'
Render in French: 'If you spoke French, you would understand.'
reference: si tu parlais français, tu comprendrais
si vous parliez français, vous comprendriez

sections.title: Part D — Multiple Choice (vocabulary and idiom)

items.prompt: What mood is required after 'il faut que'?
What is the difference between the imparfait and the passé composé?
Which preposition contracts with 'le' to form 'au'?
